thread:
Maria P: quick sync — we need to lock the convo API shape. big decision: normalized `messages: [{role, content, name?}]` array vs preserve legacy `prompt` string + metadata. customers pushing messages for role fidelity; platform wants simplicity and compatibility. thoughts?
Kevin L: +1 for messages. matches most OSS models and vendor APIs. streaming easier too. concern: token accounting and client simplicity for tiny prompts.
Samir R: agree on messages, but we need clear role semantics. proposal: request roles allowed = system,user,assistant; `assistant` allowed only in replay/migration scenarios, not for new content. system message is authoritative and can be flagged persistent in a `session_meta` layer.
Jules D: tradeoffs: message array increases request size slightly but simplifies tool/function-calling mapping. function call should attach to the last assistant message or a special `tool_call` envelope. Also need to decide if we accept `name` for user/assistant.
Kevin L: performance note — batching/kv-cache expects consistent tokenization. we can implement a thin compatibility layer that converts `prompt` -> `messages` server-side. that reduces friction for current customers.
Maria P: launch criteria suggestion: 1) SDK support in JS/Python, 2) server-side compat for `prompt` with identical semantics, 3) docs + migration guide, 4) perf parity (<=5% latency regression) on common workloads, 5) 2 pilot customers on Dedicated/Hosted.
Samir R: security + eval notes: system messages must be enforced (no user can override persisted system). audit log entry for any server-side conversion. also add E2E tests that include tool calls and structured output.
Jules D: small code example for compatibility layer we could offer in SDKs:
```js
// compat: prompt -> messages
const messages = prompt ? [{role: 'system', content: defaultSystem}, {role: 'user', content: prompt}] : messagesParam;
```
Kevin L: about `role=assistant` in requests — disallow except when `migration_mode=true` in headers. otherwise reject with 400 + migration hint. keeps runtime simpler.
Maria P: prioritization: M1 = messages array + SDK + server compat. M2 = persistent session/system meta + assistant-replay path. M3 = richer name/actor fields and per-message provenance.
Samir R: metrics to hit pre-launch: p99 latency within 1.05x of current completion endpoint, token cost delta < 3%, docs & migration guide published, 90%+ successful transforms for legacy prompts in canary.
redwood-ci: deploy triggered: feature-branch/convo-api-shape -> ci pipeline started :rocket:
Jules D: plan for rollout: beta flag by org -> staged canary -> gradual global. include fallback to legacy completions endpoint for 30 days.
Maria P: action items: Kevin to spec server compat logic and failure semantics (due EOD Tue). Samir to write system/message enforcement + tests (due Thu). Jules to update SDKs + example (due Fri). I'll coordinate pilot invites.
Kevin L: ack. will post design doc link here when ready.
Samir R: 👍
Jules D: :thumbsup: sounds good to me.
Maria P: ok, consensus to proceed with hybrid approach (messages-first, server-side prompt compat). moving to product PRD. thanks all.
